info.name: NeighborHub NEW
info.description: Standalone NeighborHub API collection reconstructed from current production runtime code. Source of truth: route definitions + controllers + form requests. Authenticated requests inherit a Bearer token from the active environment (access_token). Every request includes native saved response examples.

item.name: Reports

request.description: Requires an authenticated community manager or super admin (managerOrSuperAdmin middleware). Read-only analytics endpoint; no query parameters. NOTE: served under /api/communities/{communityId}/reports (no v1 segment). Returns post, comment, reaction and poll-vote totals plus poll participation (active residents, unique voters, percentage).

Requires an authenticated community manager or super admin (managerOrSuperAdmin middleware). Read-only analytics endpoint; no query parameters. NOTE: served under /api/communities/{communityId}/reports (no v1 segment). Returns issue totals broken down by status, category and priority, plus the average resolution time in minutes (created_at to first resolved/closed status log entry).

Requires an authenticated community manager or super admin (managerOrSuperAdmin middleware). Read-only analytics endpoint; no query parameters. NOTE: served under /api/communities/{communityId}/reports (no v1 segment). Returns per-provider performance for assigned issues: totals by status, average resolution time in minutes (assigned to resolved/closed status log entries) and completion rate percentage.

Requires an authenticated community manager or super admin (managerOrSuperAdmin middleware). Read-only analytics endpoint; no query parameters. NOTE: served under /api/communities/{communityId}/reports (no v1 segment). Returns service listing counts by type and by status, plus closure statistics: listings past their expiry but still active (automatic_expired) versus listings closed before expiry (manually_closed).

item.description: Manager/Super-Admin community analytics: engagement, issues summary, provider performance and services activity. All endpoints are read-only GETs scoped by community. NOTE: Reports routes resolve under /api/communities/{communityId}/reports/... (no v1 segment).
